// Generated companion for a private P01 adaptation. No app-kit runtime required.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// Hero contains presentation copy and destinations. Route behavior and image
// ownership remain the responsibility of the consuming application.
type Hero struct {
	LogoLightURL, LogoDarkURL, LogoAlt                     string
	Announcement, AnnouncementLabel, AnnouncementURL       string
	Heading, Introduction                                  string
	PrimaryLabel, PrimaryURL, SecondaryLabel, SecondaryURL string
	ImageURL, ImageAlt                                     string
	ImageDecorative                                        bool
}

// NewHero validates and snapshots data before returning the source-faithful
// component.
func NewHero(data Hero) (templ.Component, error) {
	if err := validateHero(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return guardedHero(hero(data)), nil
}

// NewHeroEnhanced opts into the companion CSS usability envelope. Callers must
// include that stylesheet after the source CSS.
func NewHeroEnhanced(data Hero) (templ.Component, error) {
	content, err := NewHero(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return guardedHero(heroEnhanced(content)), nil
}

func validateHero(data Hero) error {
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name  string
		value string
		limit int
	}{
		{"LogoAlt", data.LogoAlt, 256},
		{"Announcement", data.Announcement, 600},
		{"AnnouncementLabel", data.AnnouncementLabel, 100},
		{"Heading", data.Heading, 160},
		{"Introduction", data.Introduction, 1200},
		{"PrimaryLabel", data.PrimaryLabel, 100},
		{"SecondaryLabel", data.SecondaryLabel, 100},
	} {
		if !heroText(field.value, field.limit) {
			return fmt.Errorf("hero: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
	}
	for _, field := range []struct{ name, value string }{
		{"LogoLightURL", data.LogoLightURL},
		{"LogoDarkURL", data.LogoDarkURL},
		{"AnnouncementURL", data.AnnouncementURL},
		{"PrimaryURL", data.PrimaryURL},
		{"SecondaryURL", data.SecondaryURL},
		{"ImageURL", data.ImageURL},
	} {
		if !heroURL(field.value) {
			return fmt.Errorf("hero: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
	}
	if data.ImageDecorative {
		if data.ImageAlt != "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("hero: decorative image alt must be empty")
		}
	} else if !heroText(data.ImageAlt, 512) {
		return fmt.Errorf("hero: invalid ImageAlt")
	}
	return nil
}

func heroText(value string, limit int) bool {
	if len(value) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func heroURL(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 2048 || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || !utf8.ValidString(value) || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\ ") {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
	if err != nil || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range decoded {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") {
		return !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == ""
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "https://") || u.Scheme != "https" || u.Hostname() == "" || strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") || strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ") {
		return false
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func guardedHero(component templ.Component) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
			return component.Render(ctx, w)
		}
	})
}
